services.name: Anthropic (Claude API)
services.purpose: Myra's thinking (Claude Haiku 4.5) and Chronicles/Library answer generation. Two keys so the spend can be split.
services.plan: Prepaid credits — top up as needed
services.notes: Prepaid credits, no subscription. Console on 2026-09-24: balance $31.56, $3.27 spent Sep 1–24 (≈ $4/mo pace), 463.8K tokens in the last 7 days. Auto-reload is OFF; the only cap is the $500 tier limit. Myra's local metrics account for only a few cents of this, so most spend is Chronicles/Library answers. If credits hit $0, Myra drops to schedule/navigation-only answers and Chronicles falls back to Groq.

services.name: LemonSlice
services.purpose: Myra video-avatar proof of concept (scripts/start-myra-avatar-poc.ps1).
services.notes: Cancelled. Subscription ends September 29, 2026; no further charges. Was $8/mo. The Myra avatar POC stops working after that.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.purpose: Myra's live voice (Flash v2.5). Falls back to free local Kokoro if credits run out.
services.notes: Fixed monthly plan with a character quota. If usage-based overage is enabled in the account, heavy Myra use can cost more than $22 — check the Usage page.

services.name: Migadu
services.purpose: webmaster@ mailboxes on .net and .com, plus Myra's outage alert emails (SMTP).
services.notes: Renewal date assumed from the 2026-09-15 signup — verify.

services.name: Domain: suwaneegamers.net
services.purpose: Main site domain. DNS on Cloudflare.

services.name: Domain: suwaneegamers.com
services.purpose: Secondary domain, registered at Squarespace.

services.name: Claude (Pro)
services.purpose: Claude Code and Claude chat for building and maintaining the site.
services.notes: Separate from the Anthropic API credits the site itself spends.

services.name: ChatGPT (Plus)
services.purpose: ChatGPT and Codex for building and maintaining the site.

services.name: Flova.ai
services.purpose: AI video generation — made the Advents of Harmony Library entrance video and poster.
services.notes: Cancelled. Access ends October 18, 2026; no further charges. Was $20/mo. Download any generated media you want to keep before then.

services.name: Home PC + internet
services.purpose: Hosts production (NSSM SuwaneeGamers), LiveKit, Parakeet/Whisper STT on the GPU, and Kokoro — 24/7.
services.notes: Counted as free — existing home PC and internet, no added cost tracked.

services.name: Cloudflare
services.purpose: DNS, the Tunnel that publishes the site, TURN DNS updates, and edge blocking of scanners/failed logins.

services.name: Groq
services.purpose: Fallback model for Chronicles answers, only when Claude fails.
services.notes: Backup only — used when Claude fails. Free-tier rate limits apply, so if Anthropic credits run out, Library answers may be slower or throttled.

services.name: Jina AI
services.purpose: Embeddings for the Chronicles vault — nightly reindex and every lore question.
services.notes: Free tier has a token allowance. If it runs out, the nightly Chronicles reindex and every Library/Myra lore lookup (query embedding) fail — watch the balance on the dashboard.

services.name: Google Cloud
services.purpose: Drive API (image syncs), Calendar, Docs exports, and the Google sign-in OAuth client.
services.notes: Project "Local n8n". Worth a budget alert.

services.name: Discord
services.purpose: "Sign in with Discord".

services.name: GitHub
services.purpose: Actions CI and Pages for /landing.

services.name: Open-Meteo
services.purpose: Myra's weather answers. Keyless.

services.name: ipify
services.purpose: Public IP lookup that keeps the TURN DNS record current. Keyless.

services.name: Let's Encrypt
